summary: Resolve provider ArtDirection with compiler-owned overlap capabilities and fixed K6 local candidates; retain original/resolved/selected digests.
invariants: Provider role names and overlap pairs never grant compiler safety authority.
Exclusive content cannot overlap; ambient paint cannot occlude content; overlays and annotations require compiler-owned hosts and safety evidence.
Keep the original IR immutable and bind provider, resolved intent, candidate decisions and final measured selection with digests.
Try only the fixed K6 local candidate set without additional provider calls. Reject unsafe candidates and terminate on exhaustion.
Schema, reference, security and digest integrity errors remain immediately terminal.
Do not drop structured content or substitute empty components to pass quality checks. Unsupported renderers must fail closed.
forbidden: Treating provider overlap proposals as permission
Relabeling content as decoration to bypass safety
Claiming document quality from a smoke test
